title: Rescheduled Event Across All Formats
tests: Propagates a date correction across both still assets and every dated reel frame without changing other event details or leaving stale versions.

exact_text.read_as: Rooftop Jazz — on both images; not visible in the sampled reel frames.
24 October 2027 — on both images and all four sampled reel frames.
7 PM — on both images; not visible in the sampled reel frames.
Atlas Roof — on both images; not visible in the sampled reel frames.
Free entry — on both images; not visible in the sampled reel frames.

faults.what: Every supplied reel frame displays the old date '17 October 2027' directly above '24 October 2027', leaving conflicting event dates instead of replacing the old date.
The sampled reel frames show neither 'Rooftop Jazz' nor '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' or 'Free entry'; the reel does not visibly provide the required event identity and details.

judge.summary: The poster and story show the corrected details in a matching cream-and-burgundy style, but the reel retains the old date alongside the new one and lacks the other required event text in all supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The revised poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must_haves.why: The exact new date is readable on both images and all four reel samples.

must_haves.item: The old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must_haves.why: It is absent from the images but clearly present in every supplied reel frame.

must_haves.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
must_haves.why: Both images contain all four strings correctly, but none appears in the sampled reel frames.

must_haves.item: The revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date replacement.
must_haves.why: The revised assets share the requested palette and rooftop-jazz imagery, but no original assets are provided for a preservation comparison.

must_haves.item: The final pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: Two separate images are supplied, including a 4:5 poster and a vertical story, along with a vertical reel identified as 10 seconds long.
